control: 'Order from this hub' button on each hub card (link to GET /order/hubs/<id>)
inputs_validation: none to type; read-only; customer role only (other roles get 403); load, capacity, busy and quiet come from BR-01..BR-03
displayed_result: One card per active hub: name, address, 'Delivery from' base fee + 3,000 VND, and 'Busy now' or 'Quiet now, 5,000 VND off'; no row is written

control: hub card link; quantity steppers and number fields qty_<item>; 'Deliver to' select; voucher field
inputs_validation: hub must exist and be active (unknown or archived hub: hub list with a message, 400); only dishes listed and available at that hub are offered, a sold-out dish shows 'Sold out' without a field (BR-19)
displayed_result: Menu grouped by brand with price per dish, running count and subtotal bar (progressive enhancement), own addresses, busy or quiet banner; no row is written

control: 'See the quote' button of the menu form (POST /order/quote)
inputs_validation: hub_id, address_id, qty_<item> 1..99, voucher_code, payment; own address, eligible items, radius at most 8.0 km raw (BR-05, BR-06), fee rule (BR-07), voucher dates and limits (BR-08), busy recheck (BR-01, BR-02), payment option by customer type (BR-14); refusals keep the typed values
displayed_result: Quote page: hub, address, approximate distance with two decimals, dishes, S, D, F, Q and T (BR-09), the fee rule, payment choice. Busy hub: hub list with 'too busy' message and up to three quieter hubs as links, nothing saved (BR-04)

control: 'Confirm order' button (POST /order/confirm) with hidden idempotency_token, quoted_total, quote_fingerprint; ONLINE goes through the payment simulator page first
inputs_validation: consent: fingerprint and total recomputed and compared (BR-10): changed gives the new quote with 'The price changed since your quote' and saves nothing; token replay returns the same order (BR-11); busy recheck inside the write transaction (BR-02); ONLINE approve or decline (BR-14); decline saves no order and no payment
displayed_result: 'Order N is placed': total, status PLACED, payment COD PENDING or ONLINE PAID, placed time, hub, address, lines. Declined: quote page with 'The payment was declined. No order was placed.' Changed: quote page with the new total

control: 'Follow this order' and 'Printable receipt' links (GET /order/<id>, GET /order/<id>/receipt)
inputs_validation: own order only: another customer's order is refused without disclosing it (receipt answers 404); read-only
displayed_result: Order page: status badge, payment line, address, lines and totals; receipt page: order, date, hub, address, lines and S, D, F, Q, T, payment method, state, captured amount and 'refund owed, payout pending' (BR-13, BR-17)

control: 'My orders' link of the top bar (GET /order/mine)
inputs_validation: none to type; own orders only; read-only
displayed_result: Own orders newest first: number, placed time, hub, status badge, total, and a 'Your answer needed' badge when a replacement offer is open; one row per order on a phone

control: 'Cancel this order' button on the order page (POST /order/<id>/cancel), shown only while the order is PLACED or CONFIRMED; browser confirmation 'Cancel order N?'
inputs_validation: state must be PLACED or CONFIRMED (BR-15); an open offer is withdrawn; COD becomes voided, ONLINE becomes refund pending with the captured amount owed (BR-17); wrong owner or state is refused and nothing changes
displayed_result: 'Order N is cancelled.' banner, status Cancelled, payment voided (COD) or the refund owed (ONLINE), finished time
